ITEM 1 | Single wedge-shaped slice on the upper right of a white square plate, roughly 9 cm long and 5 cm wide at the widest; crust edge is golden-brown and firm with a flaky, bready texture along the outer rim; top surface is partly covered by melted, pale-yellow cheese with light browning blisters and dark red-orange tomato-sauce spots; the cheese looks slightly glossy and soft, sagging over the edge; the slice is about 2 cm thick at the crust and thinner toward the tip, with a visible layer of darker red sauce beneath the cheese; sits alone on the plate with no other food adjacent | 120

ITEM 2 | Thin red-orange tomato sauce layer visible on and beneath the cheese, dotted in spots across the slice's top surface and seeping at the lower edge; moist, slightly glossy, spreadable texture with no separate pieces | 15
